name: Senbatsu Partners
description: Senbatsu Partners is a WordPress landing theme designed for retained executive search firms, boards, and leadership consultancies. Built around a single-column longform layout with anchor navigation and clear house rules, it presents mandates, partner bios, transparent fees, and process timelines with calm typographic clarity. The theme features documentary photography, responsive fee tables, and subtle scroll motions for professional corporate presentation.

summary.en: Retained executive search landing theme: a dusk-navy diagonal hero with one partner photograph and a next-step holder, 4x2 label-above seat tiles, a transparent fee table and case letters on one long page.
